rules.name: recon-dup-02-view-join-fanout
rules.sql: SELECT CAST(:bu AS text) AS business_unit, max(h.settlement_date) AS settlement_date, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, count(DISTINCT h.trade_id) AS distinct_trade_id, count(DISTINCT h.uuid) AS distinct_uuid FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING')

WITH hb AS ( SELECT h.uuid, h.tenant_id, h.business_unit, h.p1_name, h.value_date FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), m AS ( SELECT hb.uuid, count(fp.security_id) AS c FROM hb LEFT JOIN opera.helper_calculate_future_price_view fp ON fp.tenant_id = hb.tenant_id AND fp.business_unit = hb.business_unit AND fp.security_id = hb.p1_name AND fp.value_date = hb.value_date GROUP BY hb.uuid ) SELECT 'future price view' AS join_name, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) AS joined_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) - count(*) AS extra_rows, max(c) AS max_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c > 1) AS rows_with_multi_match FROM m

WITH hb AS ( SELECT h.uuid, h.tenant_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id, h.value_date FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), m AS ( SELECT hb.uuid, count(ssv.security_id) AS c FROM hb LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table ssv ON ssv.tenant_id = hb.tenant_id AND ssv.business_unit = hb.business_unit AND ssv.security_id = hb.security_id AND ssv.value_date = hb.value_date GROUP BY hb.uuid ) SELECT 'security_settlement_value_table' AS join_name, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) AS joined_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) - count(*) AS extra_rows, max(c) AS max_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c > 1) AS rows_with_multi_match FROM m

WITH hb AS ( SELECT h.uuid, h.tenant_id, h.business_unit, h.trade_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), m AS ( SELECT hb.uuid, count(a.trade_id) AS c FROM hb LEFT JOIN opera.helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table a ON a.tenant_id = hb.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = hb.business_unit AND a.trade_id = hb.trade_id GROUP BY hb.uuid ) SELECT 'actual snapshot (published)' AS join_name, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) AS joined_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) - count(*) AS extra_rows, max(c) AS max_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c > 1) AS rows_with_multi_match FROM m

WITH hb AS ( SELECT h.uuid, h.tenant_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), m AS ( SELECT hb.uuid, count(sp.security_id) AS c FROM hb LEFT JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view sp ON sp.tenant_id = hb.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = hb.business_unit AND sp.security_id = hb.security_id GROUP BY hb.uuid ) SELECT 'pricing and traders view' AS join_name, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) AS joined_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) - count(*) AS extra_rows, max(c) AS max_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c > 1) AS rows_with_multi_match FROM m

WITH hb AS ( SELECT h.uuid, h.tenant_id, h.business_unit, h.source_trade_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), m AS ( SELECT hb.uuid, count(fx.trade_id) AS c FROM hb LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = hb.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = hb.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = hb.source_trade_id GROUP BY hb.uuid ) SELECT 'fx_nc_factor_view' AS join_name, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) AS joined_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) - count(*) AS extra_rows, max(c) AS max_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c > 1) AS rows_with_multi_match FROM m

WITH hb AS ( SELECT h.uuid, h.tenant_id, h.business_unit, h.source_trade_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = :bu AND h.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), m AS ( SELECT hb.uuid, count(ty.trade_id) AS c FROM hb LEFT JOIN opera.helper_calculate_trade_price_yield_view ty ON ty.tenant_id = hb.tenant_id AND ty.business_unit = hb.business_unit AND ty.trade_id = hb.source_trade_id GROUP BY hb.uuid ) SELECT 'trade price yield view' AS join_name, count(*) AS snapshot_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) AS joined_rows, sum(GREATEST(c, 1)) - count(*) AS extra_rows, max(c) AS max_matches, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c > 1) AS rows_with_multi_match FROM m

expect.reason: the BU has a published settle snapshot
every published snapshot row has its own uuid
future price view: at most one row per security and value date
security_settlement_value_table: at most one row per security and value date
published actual snapshot: at most one row per trade
pricing and traders view: at most one row per security
fx_nc_factor_view: at most one row per trade
trade price yield view: at most one row per trade
